summaries.summary: A 2x2 matrix diagram illustrating market positioning based on 'Market Head' (vertical axis) and 'Differentiation' (horizontal axis). The quadrants are labeled: 'Competitive' (High Market Head, Low Differentiation), 'Focus' (High Market Head, High Differentiation), 'Avoid' (Low Market Head, Low Differentiation), and 'Niche' (Low Market Head, High Differentiation). The 'Niche' quadrant represents a market with low consumer interest (low market head) but high differentiation.
key_facts: The diagram uses 'Market Head' and 'Differentiation' as axes.
The 'Niche' quadrant corresponds to low market head (low consumer interest) and high differentiation.
The 'Avoid' quadrant represents low market head and low differentiation.
